## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I used synthetic or irreversibly anonymized fixtures and removed secrets/private trace data.
- [ ] I preserved append-only raw facts and deterministic reducer commit ownership.
- [ ] I updated schema/migration/API/generated contracts together where applicable.
- [ ] I ran the required checks, or documented each skipped check and its risk.
- [ ] I updated user/developer documentation and `docs/project/progress.md` where applicable.
- [ ] My commits include a DCO `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`).
